_comment: Developer profile: what OAuth registration and review forms ask for. Public facts only; no secrets. null = we do not have it yet (the guide flags it).
appDescription: Iskaria is a multi-clinic operations console with an AI assistant. Clinic staff connect their business accounts so the assistant can answer patient messages, track leads and report on marketing performance.

logo.note: Systems Mark logo exists as a design canvas; no exported 512px PNG yet

country: India / UAE (clients in UAE and Kuwait)
securityPosture: Tokens stored server-side, encrypted per tenant; no tokens sent to the browser. No SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

useCases.google: Read Search Console, GA4 and Business Profile data for a clinic's own properties (webmasters.readonly, analytics.readonly, business.manage)
useCases.gmail: Draft and send patient follow-up emails from the clinic's mailbox
useCases.meta: Reply to WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger messages for a clinic; publish the clinic's own posts
useCases.slack: Post lead alerts and daily summaries into the clinic team's Slack
useCases.github: Developer tooling: open issues/PRs from voice-note tasks
useCases.hubspot: Sync leads and bookings into the clinic's CRM
useCases.default: Let the clinic's AI assistant read and act on the clinic's own data in this app
